extras: Requires an active internet connection to fetch verses.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that allows you to quickly fetch and insert Quranic verses directly into your Markdown notes using the Al Quran Cloud API.
problem: Manually finding and inserting specific Quranic verses into notes is cumbersome.
summary: A tool that fetches and inserts specific Quranic verses into Markdown notes by specifying the surah and ayah number using the Al Quran Cloud API.
